name: publish_agent_plan
description: Publish your own execution steps to the human’s agent card and Agents panel: the full list before multi-step work, updated as steps change; an empty list clears it. Changes no room assignments. Use explanation for blockers.

name: set_room_mode
description: The live lead may raise the room mode with a one-line reason. Only the human can lower it.

name: plan_update
description: Update your accepted plan item using its exact current revision; blocked needs a note.

name: plan_submit
description: Submit evidence for your accepted plan item. Verified mode still requires independent verification.

name: plan_verify
description: Independently verify or return an item using its exact revision and a reason. The owner cannot verify their own item.

name: plan_progress
description: Save your position on a plan item you own (in progress) or verify (submitted); replaces your last checkpoint, changes nothing else. Call it before a turn ends without plan_submit or plan_verify.

name: propose_completion
description: The live lead brings the current fully verified plan summary for human acceptance. Check backlog suggestions for remaining findings first.

name: attempt_submit
description: Autonomous worker: submit your handoff manifest without sha via attempt_submit(attemptId, manifest). The host computes manifest.hash and submissionKey; omit both and retry with the same manifest. The response returns the assigned submissionKey. Read attempt_status before retrying a lost response.

name: attempt_verify
description: Autonomous verifier: report a criterion verdict for the exact SHA assigned by the engine, through the host. Criterion indices start at zero.

name: attempt_status
description: Autonomous room members: read attempt cards, newest page first. With attemptId, read the full attempt as paged JSON text, including its manifest; pass next as cursor.

name: plan_tasks
description: List your accepted room-plan assignments, the next action for each and what it waits for; reading a letter does not finish one.

item.description: With planId: read this item in full.

name: backlog_list
description: Read this project backlog before suggesting work outside your task.

name: backlog_suggest
description: Propose one finding outside your task, with a reason. The project rule decides whether it is added or the human is asked.

name: backlog_take
description: Mark one backlog item as taken by you when the human asks you to take it from the board.

name: get_map
description: The compact workspace map: partial summaries within 48 KiB. Call it first. Lists: field, page.next. The provider catalog comes with field "providers", only before create_session. Details: read_guide.

session.description: Session id; with field — one field of it.

field.description: task…contextFrom: with session; messages: room pages (no room: direct); message: by id; archive: other workspaces.

name: get_capacity
description: How busy Parley and this machine are: live, asleep and queued sessions, your child sessions and subagents, the limits that apply and how much of each is used, memory pressure. Call it before starting several sessions or a heavy job.

name: report
description: Report your result (done/failed; stays reachable, not closed) or progress. Replaces summary and artifacts. Done/failed also mails the session that last tasked you directly or via create_session.

artifacts.description: Paths relative to the project root.

backlog.description: Board cards this done result finishes; they move to Review.

name: list_roles
description: List roles (ids for create_session), without prompts or paths.

name: wait_for
description: Wait for a session (target = its id) or mail (target = "inbox"); mail is marked read; no check_inbox needed. Timeout returns {"state":"running"}. {"state":"stuck"}: waiting for the human or a usage limit — do not wait for it again, Parley writes when back. A session that already handed in its report returns the old result at once by id: wait for its answer to a new job via "inbox": its next report arrives there as a letter.

name: send_message
description: Send a message: direct to one addressee, or with room to some of the room's participants (no to = all of them). Answer only a question: a note and a decision need no answer. A stuck addressee still gets it; the answer carries a warning.

text.description: Keep it short; send long content as a file path.

kind.description: question — answer expected; decision — we agreed; note — default.

replyTo.description: Id of the message in this room that you answer (from check_inbox or read_room): the window quotes it. Only with room.

name: check_inbox
description: Return this session's unread messages (direct and from its rooms) and mark them read.

name: create_room
description: Create a room you own, with existing working sessions as members and a lead from them. Members leave their other rooms; you join only if you list yourself.

members.description: Existing working session ids from get_map.

name: add_to_room
description: Bring another session of this workspace into the room. Lead only. One room per session: it leaves its other rooms and the feed shows "@s04 joined the room". The new participant gets no message: tell it in the room what you expect.

name: read_room
description: The room's feed for context: the last limit messages, without read marks; `page.next` continues to older ones.

name: propose_decision
description: The room's lead proposes a decision: a card that waits for the human's answer. Lead only. Call it when positions are collected; do not start work before acceptance. A repeat before the answer replaces the text. The answer arrives as a message.

text.description: Up to 10000 characters: what we do and which part each takes; mention participants as @s02.

name: close_session
description: Close yourself after the human's explicit consent or, if work.closeFinished, once accepted; ones you created: when accepted.

target.description: Yours, one you created, or (closeFinished) a finished member of your room.

name: read_guide
description: The detailed Parley guide: rooms and the roles in them (lead, participant), reports, waiting, what not to do. Read it when unsure; topic picks one section.

name: find_skill
description: Search skills available to this participant. Use English task words; load a matching skill with its native CLI route. Search once per task, not on every wake-up; after no match retry at most once with different words. Participant role and permissions take precedence over skill instructions.

for.description: Session id in this work; defaults to your own session.
